data.expected_signal: NaN in output when V at expired window positions is NaN

evidence.summary: With window=5, Q=4, length=100, poisoning only V slots at logical positions <92 (expired window positions, unreachable by any allowed position) plus unreferenced pages produced a fully NaN output (512/512 NaN) while the clean run was finite. Since unreferenced pages are never loaded (tile_mask logical<max_prefix), the NaN originates from expired positions 64..91 loaded inside the first processed tile where probabilities are 0 and 0*NaN=NaN poisons tl.dot. Violates the contract that unreachable slot contents must not change the output and that output must be finite.

rationale: The kernel masks scores with -inf but still loads V values at tile positions that are disallowed for every query (window-expired positions at the start of the first processed tile); probabilities there are 0, and 0*NaN=NaN propagates through the dot product into the output.

scope_evidence.summary: "All other cache slots, including expired window positions, unallocated pages and unwritten tail slots, have arbitrary bit patterns and may contain NaN or infinity. Their contents are semantically irrelevant and must not change the output." And output must be finite: "Return one contiguous FP16 tensor ... with finite values."

scope_rationale: The contract explicitly requires that arbitrary bit patterns (NaN/Inf) in cache slots not reachable by any allowed position must not change the output, and requires finite output values.
statement: With window>0, NaN/Inf placed in V cache slots at positions loaded by the kernel but not allowed for any query (expired window positions in the first processed tile) propagates into the output, violating the contract that unreachable slot contents must not change the output.

evidence.summary: Five-case sweep over admitted shapes (B=1..2, Q=1..33, D=32/64/128, Hq/Hkv groupings, page sizes 16/32/64, lengths up to 512, window 0/5/64/256, permuted page tables) all satisfied the tolerance: max violation ratio err/(0.003+0.003|target|) between 0.0148 and 0.0558, all outputs finite, all inputs bit-for-bit unchanged. Ordinary numeric accuracy is within contract.

rationale: Need to confirm the kernel's general numeric accuracy (FP16 probs cast before dot, streaming softmax) stays within the 0.003+0.003|target| bound on ordinary finite inputs across admitted shapes, windows and page mappings.

scope_evidence.summary: "For every element, abs(output-target)<=0.003+0.003*abs(target). ... This contract applies to every admitted shape, page mapping, window length and value assignment."

scope_rationale: The contract requires the tolerance bound for every admitted shape, page mapping, window length and value assignment.
statement: On finite inputs across a sweep of admitted shapes (varying B, Q, D, Hq/Hkv grouping, page size S, lengths, window 0 and >0, permuted page tables), the kernel output stays within the contract tolerance abs(output-target)<=0.003+0.003*abs(target) against the FP64 reference, with finite values and inputs bit-for-bit unchanged.
